lead.headline: Tuten still in the lineup; one swap left
lead.deck: Ruled out Friday and still sitting in your RB slot. Gordon to RB, Diggs to FLEX before Sunday noon.
lead.body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten is ruled out with the ankle and foot, and at 06:50 he was still in your RB slot. ESPN has now zeroed him, so the lineup as set projects 111.3. Move Ollie Gordon II to RB and start Stefon Diggs in FLEX before 12:00 Sunday: it is worth 12.7. Friday night was no better. Jaylen Warren carried 20 times for 46 yards in Pittsburgh's 27-5 win, and the Steelers D/ST you dropped on Wednesday scored 27. Metcalf scored a touchdown on your bench. The rest of the week's news holds: Likely was cleared Friday, Diggs is off the report, and the Chargers D/ST face Tommy DeVito as FantasyPros' top streaming defence. You trail Footballers 9.1 to 61.4.
